name: Lensa AI
tagline: Lensa AI is a photo editing app by Prisma Labs that went viral for its Magic Avatars feature, which generates artistic AI portraits from selfies. Beyond avatars, it offers real-time face retouching, background blur, and a suite of AI photo enhancement filters. Available on iOS and Android.
